Name: Recolors to match Eemiestardew's color pallet
Author: Allayna
Description:
[font=Arial][size=2]04/16- [font=Arial][size=2]
XNb files are now easier to use, no need to rename stuff.
Now you can get just my bin, fences, and barrels using Content Patcher![/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=2]------------------------------------------[/size][/font]

Recolor of the shipping box, fences, signposts, and a couple barrels in camp, to match Eemiestardew's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687/]Dark Wood and Gold Craftables[/url]. Was tired of them not matching the rest of the camp.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1543/?]Eemie Tile Fixes[/url] from Zander included in xnb files
---- There was an error in Zander's summer tilesheet, now fixed in 3.5. I have reported this error to him.
------------------------------------------

For those looking to combine these edits with others -
In the outdoortilesheet files-
For the fence and the base of the shipping box -
Across the top of the images, look for the fourth full tree, then straight down several rows. You'll see both the shipping box and the fences
and signposts I recolored. [url=http://]screenshot[/url]
For the barrels -
Look straight up from the old beat up building in the bottom right corner, beside the image of the water pouring from a wall. [url=http://]screenshot
[/url]
in cursors file-
the animations for the shipping box are near the top, a long horizontal line of images
[/size][/font]
